records.short_description: [P1] Outdated software with known vulnerabilities on Citrix gateway (portal.novarefino.example:443)
records.description:
Confirm the exact installed version and the vendor advisory for every CVE listed.
Apply the vendor fixed release (or the supported LTS branch) through the normal change process; emergency change if the CVE is in CISA KEV.
If patching must wait, apply the vendor workaround or put the service behind an allowlist / WAF virtual patch and document the compensating control with an expiry date.
Add the component to the software inventory (SBOM / CMDB) so the next advisory is matched automatically.
records.u_acceptance_criteria:
Re-run the version detection scan (nmap -sV --script vulners) and confirm the banner or package reports the fixed version.
Re-run the original exploit check (non-destructive) and confirm it fails.

records.short_description: [P1] Interim detection while F-002 is open: T1190, T1210 on Citrix gateway
records.description:
Alert on exploitation patterns for the listed CVEs at the edge (WAF/IDS) and on unexpected child processes of the service.
Map the rule to ATT&CK T1190, T1210 and tag alerts with F-002.
Keep the rule active until the fix ticket is verified closed.
records.u_acceptance_criteria: Trigger a safe simulation of the technique and confirm the alert reaches the SOC queue.

records.short_description: [P2] Industrial control protocol reachable from outside the OT zone on PLC crude distillation unit (plc-cdu-01.ot.novarefino.example:502)
records.description:
Do NOT scan aggressively or patch live controllers: open a Management of Change (MOC) with Process Safety before any intervention.
Contain first: add a deny rule at the IT/OT boundary (conduit) so the protocol is only reachable from the engineering workstations and historian in the OT DMZ (zones and conduits model, IEC 62443 style).
Enable the controller's write-protection / run-mode key or protocol allowlist where the vendor supports it.
Plan the permanent fix (firmware, segmentation redesign) for the next scheduled turnaround and record it in the plant maintenance system.
records.u_acceptance_criteria:
Passive check: from the corporate IT VLAN, a single TCP connect test (nc -zv <ip> <port>) must fail; no active protocol scanning on production.
OT-ENG confirms with the asset owner that HMI/historian communication is unaffected (sign-off in MOC).

records.short_description: [P2] Interim detection while F-009 is open: T0883, T0886, T1692 on PLC crude distillation unit
records.description:
SOC + OT-ENG: passive OT network monitoring rule for any IT-sourced Modbus/S7/DNP3/EtherNet-IP session, and for write/program-download function codes.
Map the rule to ATT&CK T0883, T0886, T1692 and tag alerts with F-009.
Keep the rule active until the fix ticket is verified closed.
records.u_acceptance_criteria: Trigger a safe simulation of the technique and confirm the alert reaches the SOC queue.

records.short_description: [P2] Database or cache service reachable without network restriction on ERP database (erp-db01.corp.novarefino.example:1433)
records.description:
Bind the service to the application subnet only and add a host firewall rule allowing just the app servers.
Require authentication and TLS for every client connection; remove anonymous or default accounts.
Move the database into a dedicated data tier segment if it currently shares the user VLAN.
records.u_acceptance_criteria:
From a user-VLAN host, nmap -p <db port> <host> must report filtered.
Unauthenticated connection attempt must be refused.

records.description:

records.short_description: [P2] Assess personal-data impact of F-018 on ERP database
records.description:
Check access logs for the exposure window together with SOC.
Decide whether the incident threshold for GDPR Art. 33 notification (72 h to the authority) is met and document the decision.
Record the finding and treatment in the risk register / RoPA.
records.u_acceptance_criteria: Decision recorded with date and signatory.

records.short_description: [P3] Remote administration service reachable from untrusted networks on 10.10.9.99 (not in inventory) (10.10.9.99:5900)
records.description:
Remove the direct exposure: close the port on the perimeter firewall / security group for any source outside the admin allowlist.
Publish remote administration only through the corporate VPN or a zero-trust access broker with MFA.
Enforce Network Level Authentication (RDP) or key-only authentication (SSH) and disable password logins for privileged accounts.
Record the rule change with ticket ID in the firewall change log.
records.u_acceptance_criteria:
From an external vantage point, nmap -Pn -p <port> <public IP> must report filtered/closed.
Confirm the service is still reachable through the VPN / broker path for authorised admins.

records.short_description: [P3] SNMP v1/v2c with default or guessable community string on Core switch (core-sw01.corp.novarefino.example:161)
records.description:
Migrate the device to SNMPv3 with authPriv (SHA-2 + AES).
If v2c must stay temporarily, set a long random read-only community and an ACL that allows only the NMS address.
Disable SNMP write access entirely.
records.u_acceptance_criteria:
nmap -sU -p161 --script snmp-info <host> with 'public' must fail.
NMS still polls the device over SNMPv3.

records.short_description: [P4] Cleartext management or file-transfer protocol in use on Control room printer (prn-ctrlroom.corp.novarefino.example:21)
records.description:
Replace Telnet with SSH and FTP with SFTP/FTPS; disable the cleartext daemon after migration.
Rotate every credential that was ever used over the cleartext protocol.
Block the cleartext port at the host firewall so it cannot be re-enabled silently.
records.u_acceptance_criteria:
nmap -p 21,23 <host> must report closed/filtered.
Confirm that the replacement encrypted service accepts logins with rotated credentials.

records.short_description: Approve remediation plan: 11 P1/P2 findings, resources and risk acceptances
records.description:
Review the executive summary and the department distribution table.
Confirm owners and SLAs, or formally accept residual risk per finding (named owner + expiry date).
Schedule a weekly 15-minute remediation stand-up until all P1/P2 are verified closed.
records.u_acceptance_criteria: Signed approval or risk acceptance attached to every P1/P2 finding.
